title: get_projects_api_should_return_user_projects_list

title: post_api_ai_chat_should_return_streaming_raga_aware_responses
description: Verify POST /api/ai/chat returns a streaming SSE response for raga-related questions. Use Authorization header: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJFUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IjkyYjIyYjdkLWZmM2UtNDVlYS1iYjFhLWJlYTY5NmJlNmViNiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..JRZAqrvfVcM_yB9G6Dg--rqIuL-kDSl6rmc196Z7ytarIqXtZBP8MZPjKrj-hbg8PEKwEOY9bOgBoUPVmIGcgg. Send body: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What are the key characteristics of Bhairavi raga?"}]}. Expect HTTP 200 and a text/event-stream response containing data: lines with raga content.

title: post_api_export_midi_should_download_valid_midi_file

title: get_api_projects_should_return_401_without_auth
description: Verify that GET /api/projects returns 401 Unauthorized when called without an Authorization header. No auth header should be sent. Expect HTTP 401 and an error message in the JSON response.
